cases.note: prod SLAYR 'Phone (Interlude)' (ISRC USSM12600221) replaced while it carried no catalog length: the stored file measured 112 s (the YouTube Music art track) and MusicBrainz registers e7ca1ccd at 128 s (live). The measured 112 s is only the stored length that excludes the art track; it is neither the target nor the resolver query length, so the artist's own 129 s upload is judged against 128 s and stored. The eval harness builds the track ref directly, so the ledger half of this fix is proven by TestGetNeverAimsAtTheLastMeasuredFile and TestExecuteReplace_TheStoredLengthIsNotTheTarget
